versions.content: function SetFileSize [SWS_PER_00428] Upstream: RS_PER_00001 , RS_PER_00004 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_ AP_00128, RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < void > SetFileSize ( std::uint64_t size) noexcept; Reduces the size of the file to ’size’, effectively removing the current content of the file beyond this size. The current file position is unchanged if it is lower than ’size’, or set to the last valid position in the file otherwise. If ’size’ is 0, the current file position will also be set to 0.
